rationale: All 4 prior blocking findings are resolved, checked against the source at HEAD b29ec3d3 (the fix-up diff matches): copilotRunWindows now looks up on-disk bounds for every started run and uses the earlier of those and the loaded-sibling bound, with a cost-enricher test, and copilot-cli.analytics.test.ts now covers both delete paths, run-scoped skills and the shutdown lines/files subtraction. CR-001..003 were test gaps, so they were resolved through the changed test file and not their own source paths. Tests were not run because Stage 7 owns execution, and no new findings were sought.

finding_status.notes: Two new tests at HEAD: telemetry deletedPaths drives the deleted.has branch (telemetry paths present), and an apply_patch Delete File header with no telemetry drives PATCH_OPERATION; both assert type 'delete'.
New test adds skill.invoked inside run A's window (150) and run C's window (1150); the bounded parses assert {skill-a:1} and {skill-c:1}.
New test: shutdown {2,[x]} before resume, {5,[x,y]} in run C; asserts C's fileOperations is [{edit y, +3, -0}], pinning the subtraction and the priorFiles filter.

copilotRunWindows now batches nextRecordStarts for every started run and bounds each run by earliest(sibling, disk); its only consumer reads bounds.get. New cost-enricher test checks A bounded at 2000, not 3000.
